_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
OBJECTIVE: Proactive Strategic Advisor: from a capability consulted by the Orchestrator to a scheduled one that observes the laboratory, compares directions against the operator's roadmap and prepares assignments for the relevant sessions without being asked; first pilot 24 h, at most 3 strategic invocations and 3 assignments, no external spend, no change to scientific guarantees. Implementation evidence is kept apart from the pilot result; the campaign stays open with the Orchestrator as verified operational owner.
